overview.description: The AAM S&P 500 High Dividend Value ETF (SPDV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks an index of US large-caps selected for high dividend and free-cash-flow yields. Securities are equally-weighted. SPDV was launched on Nov 28, 2017 and is issued by Advisors Asset Management.
